gaps.sentence: "Can you help me?" — She asked ___ help her.
'I work from home on Fridays,' he explained. He explained that he ___ from home on Fridays.
gaps.explanation: After a past reporting verb, present simple backshifts to past simple: work → worked.

gaps.sentence: She ___ me not to worry about the deadline.
gaps.hint: tell sb not to do sth
gaps.explanation: Only 'tell' takes a personal object + not to + infinitive; 'said me not to' is impossible.

gaps.sentence: 'I'll carry those bags for you,' he said. He ___ to carry my bags.
gaps.explanation: Offers of help are reported as offered to do something.

gaps.sentence: They ___ us that the museum had closed early.
gaps.explanation: Tell somebody (that)... — 'told' needs the direct personal object 'us'; 'said' cannot take it.

gaps.sentence: 'I'm meeting them tomorrow evening,' she said. She said she was meeting them ___ evening.
gaps.explanation: Tomorrow evening becomes the next (or the following) evening.

gaps.sentence: "Congratulations!" — She ___ me on passing the exam.
'I'll call you later,' he promised. He promised that he ___ call me later.
gaps.explanation: Will backshifts to would in reported speech.
